AcceptedWarning.description:
A check warning the engineer accepted, with the reason (ADR 0036). It matches a
warning by check id, panel and subject.
AcceptedWarning.title: AcceptedWarning

BaseFrame.description: The plinth under the enclosure (spec: Inputs, 2. Panel definition).
BaseFrame.title: BaseFrame

CableDefaults.description:
Cord lengths per link class for the cable suggestions (plan M65, Q66): within one
cabinet, between cabinets, and leaving the substation when the link row gives none.
CableDefaults.title: CableDefaults

CableRef.description: What a loose row that is a cable connects, for the Cable Schedule (ADR 0035, M65).
CableRef.title: CableRef

CalcSheet.description: A calculation sheet's register document and its scope line.
CalcSheet.title: CalcSheet

CatalogueChoice.description: The brand set picked per catalogue; unset means ``default``.
CatalogueChoice.title: CatalogueChoice

ConstantOverrides.description: Design constants as written in a file; unwritten keys keep the inherited value.
ConstantOverrides.title: ConstantOverrides

DesignBasis.description:
What the engineer states first (ADR 0031). It only sets defaults: a value the
substation writes itself wins. Unset keys mean today's behaviour.
DesignBasis.title: DesignBasis

DeviceMove.description:
Move single units into a panel; a redundant entry's move names its side.

``position`` (1 = top) is the unit's place among the panel's rack devices; ``top_u``
fixes the top of its block at that rack U (1 = bottom). Without either the unit takes
its automatic place in the panel (ADR 0013, R7).
DeviceMove.title: DeviceMove

Enclosure.description: The cabinet enclosure (spec: Inputs, 2. Panel definition).
Enclosure.title: Enclosure

Equipment.description: A device the substation needs, before any panel exists (ADR 0013).
Equipment.title: Equipment

ExternalLink.description: A link leaving the substation, e.g. to the control centre or PCC (plan M61, Q64).
ExternalLink.title: ExternalLink

GeneratedPanels.description: Identity of the panels the layout writes; ``{n}`` is the panel number (ADR 0013).
GeneratedPanels.title: GeneratedPanels

IedRow.description: One row of the IED schedule: ``qty`` IEDs of one type in one bay (ADR 0034).
IedRow.title: IedRow

IssueRecord.description:
One issued workbook (ADR 0036): ``file`` is relative to ``substation.yaml`` when
inside the project folder, ``sha256`` the file as written.
IssueRecord.title: IssueRecord

Layout.description: Layout inputs; the usable U per panel is computed, not written (ADR 0013).
Layout.title: Layout

LooseExtra.description:
A loose-material row: a library part, optionally with kit children and a feeding
panel, or a free-text item with only a description (ADR 0022).
LooseExtra.title: LooseExtra

title.default: PSA Panels Loose Material and Auxiliary Equipment
title.title: Title

OutputSettings.description:
Workbook file name template, the names of the generated sheets, and the footnotes the
Power Consumption sheet prints after its NOTES (spec: Power Consumption sheet).
OutputSettings.title: OutputSettings

PairMove.description: Move both sides of a redundant entry (its ``unit``-th pair, or all) into two panels.
PairMove.title: PairMove

PartOverrides.description: Library values replaced for one equipment entry (ADR 0024).
PartOverrides.title: PartOverrides

PortAllocation.description: A count of ports of one speed and media used for one purpose, plus spares.
PortAllocation.title: PortAllocation

PortNeed.description: Ports one IED needs on each side it attaches to (ADR 0034).
PortNeed.title: PortNeed

PortPlan.description: How one device's ports are allocated (keyed by part id or tag in the panel).
PortPlan.title: PortPlan

SfpChoice.description:
The SFP model picked for one port speed and media of a switch (ADR 0024), and the
spare and extra SFPs on each of its BOM rows (plan M49). No ``part_id`` keeps the
automatic pick; no ``spare`` keeps the project's.
SfpChoice.title: SfpChoice

SpareExtra.description: A spare the policy does not give: a library part or a free-text item (plan M64).
SpareExtra.title: SpareExtra

Spares.description: Every spare as a user input, defaults as today (ADR 0013).
Spares.title: Spares

SparesList.description:
The substation's edits to the spares list (plan M64): a spare quantity per ordering
code (the model when a part has none), codes left out, and extra items.
SparesList.title: SparesList

SparesPolicy.description: The spares list's policy (ADR 0031); read by the spares list (plan M64) only.
SparesPolicy.title: SparesPolicy

Tagging.description: How device tags print their side and number (ADR 0030, 0031); defaults are today's.
Tagging.title: Tagging

UnitRef.description: Units of one equipment entry: ``unit`` (1-based) and ``side``; None means all.
UnitRef.title: UnitRef
